name: @pipeworx/mcp-outlook-mail

tools.name: outlook_list_messages
tools.description: List email messages from an Outlook / Microsoft 365 mailbox folder (default: inbox). Returns compact message summaries (subject, sender, received time, preview, read status, attachment flag). Supports keyword search and unread-only filtering. Use to browse a user's Outlook email.

folder.description: Mail folder to read from (default: "inbox"). Use a well-known name like "inbox", "sentitems", "drafts", "deleteditems", or a folder ID from outlook_list_folders.

top.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 25, max 100).

search.description: Optional free-text keyword search across the messages (subject, body, sender, etc.).

unread_only.description: If true, return only unread messages.

tools.name: outlook_get_message
tools.description: Get the full content of a single Outlook / Microsoft 365 email message by its ID, including subject, sender, recipients (to/cc), received time, and the full body (HTML or text). Use after outlook_list_messages or outlook_search_messages to read an email in full.

id.description: The ID of the email message to retrieve (from a list or search result).

tools.name: outlook_list_folders
tools.description: List the mail folders in an Outlook / Microsoft 365 mailbox, with display names, unread counts, and total item counts. Use to discover folder names/IDs before listing messages.

tools.name: outlook_search_messages
tools.description: Search across an entire Outlook / Microsoft 365 mailbox by keyword. Returns matching email summaries (subject, sender, received time, preview). Use to find emails by topic, sender, or content regardless of folder.

query.description: Free-text search query to match against email messages.

top.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 25).

tools.name: outlook_get_profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Microsoft 365 / Outlook profile: display name, email address, user principal name, job title, and mobile phone. Use to identify whose mailbox is connected.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-outlook-mail forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the outlook-mail pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
